headline: Elected Don Slish as new Vice-Chair; heard tenant-landlord case for 131 Ledgewood Circle with no recorded outcome.
summary: The board held a hearing on a dispute between tenants Annamma and William Johns and landlords Caleb and Mallory Pillsbury over 131 Ledgewood Circle, Burlington, VT. Both parties presented evidence and testimony, and the hearing was closed. The board also elected Don Slish as the new vice-chair.
decisions: Elected Don Slish as the new vice-chair of the Housing Board, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Don Slish was unanimously elected to be the new vice-chair of the Housing Board.

plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, July 20, 2026 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
Remotely via Zoom  https://zoom.us/u/aefS34a5v6  
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Don Slish, Olivia Taylor, Emma Ramirez-Richer and Dylan 
Shelby 
Staff present: Shay Brunvand 
Meeting called to order at 06:30 PM 
1. Annamma and William Johns (tenants); Caleb and Mallory Pillsbury (landlords) Re: 131 
Ledgewood Circle, Burlington, VT 
 
Present were Annamma Johns, William Johns, and Caleb Pillsbury. 
 
Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was closed.  
 
2. Electing a new Vice-Chair 
Don Slish was unanimously elected to be the new vice-chair of the Housing Board.  
 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 7:02 PM 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
